_purpose: Cowork-owned interpretation layer for the SEC filings feed. Append-only. NEVER regenerated or overwritten by any fetcher or script. Each row interprets and taxonomy-tags one material item drawn from the raw feed named in source_feed. Held in a separate file from the raw feed because that feed is overwritten in full on every fetch (a news refresh once wiped 150 entity-tagged items — see data_exposure/interpretation separation).
source_feed_owner: scripts/fetch_filings.py (SEC EDGAR) — fetcher-owned, overwritten in full on each run
dedup_key_note: The raw filing row carries no standalone accession field; the SEC accession is embedded in the EDGAR url as /Archives/edgar/data/<cik>/<accession_clean>/. Dedup on the url, or parse the accession out of it — both are stable per filing.
enum_authority: data/registries/taxonomy.json — sectors, subsectors and the 9 value_chain_tier values are authoritative there (also listed in CLAUDE.md).
